findings.summary: Ollama silently truncates prompts to num_ctx default (4096); advertised 131072 is not effective. HTTP 200 + plausible wrong answer.
findings.resolution: Per-call num_ctx + prompt_eval_count assertion + TruncationError. Verified real Ollama.

findings.summary: attempt_no restarted at 1 on requeue -> UNIQUE collision -> requeued call marked failed. Broke machine-sleep recovery.
system_prompt silently dropped (snake_case vs camelCase). Presented as a bad-prompt/model failure — the exact BDD-018 misattribution trap.
findings.resolution: normalizeCallInput accepts both spellings and throws on unknown fields.

findings.summary: ndcgForJudgments returned 0 for a ranking with no parsed judgments — a confident wrong number.
findings.resolution: Refuse to score incomplete judgments; return null + error.

findings.summary: Token estimator under-counted chat-template scaffolding ~2x (claimed to over-count).
findings.resolution: Measured overhead 48 tokens/message; layer-2 num_ctx check remains the authority.

findings.summary: Two empty tiles in the dashboard status strip (visual imbalance).
Trace detail is raw JSON (browser viewer), not a designed trace page. Acceptable for an internal tool; a rendered trace view foregrounding the diagnosis block is a future enhancement.

residual_risks: Fairness floor number is a default pending OQ-4.
First live eval-reports NDCG blocked upstream (R-12) until candidate capture + stable IDs land in ecommmerce-eval.
